name: 一覧表示の切り替え帯
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Correct only typography and framing in image1, the generated Lighthouse LH09-0003 toolbar.
Reference hierarchy: ORIGINAL image2 controls icon glyphs, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment and small detail anatomy. Japanese mock image3 is secondary for locked Meiryo Regular14/24 typography and Japanese text. Its rough placeholder icons are not authority.
All three Japanese pill labels 「すべて」「実行中」「未着手」 are too bold in image1. Make them normal Meiryo Regular weight400, visibly thinner stems, matching image3. No bold or semibold labels. Preserve exact wording and keep font scale consistent with original 960x48 logical toolbar. Tightly frame the toolbar with minimal padding above/below if possible.
Keep image1's forest-green gradient selectedpill, white selectedtext, white outlined secondarypills, restored diamond/stackplus action, and all three source-accurate round utilitybuttons. Preserve filter three descendingbars, two sliders withroundknobs and rightpartition panel exactly. Keep slate utilityicons, pure white canvas, fine neutral borders and restrained soft shadows.
No added row, title, controls, labels, metrics or content. Change only label weight and framing; do not copy source English. One component only.
reviewNotes: 一度の限定修正を実見。三状態と四つの原画像由来アイコンを保持。文字の重さは少し改善したが指定Regularとの一致を未確認、上下余白過大も残る。要修正を保持し他の実部品へ進む。画像と目録の保存は機能受入・所有者承認とは別。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

references.acquisitionRoute: Chromeで観察した公開画像URLまたは文書化された画像保存

regionEvidence.value: 一覧の上部。すべて・実行中・未着手と右側の絞り込み/表示操作。
